title: feat(spec)!: retire PositionGrantVia 'name' and the Setup by-name grant readers
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB6HyysmaMsguGWxWciWzUMt)_
Fixes #26022

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`PositionGrantVia` 收窄为只剩 `'definition'`;Setup 岗位列表去掉「（同名）」徽标及其两个 i18n 键;托管环境 Users 页的「未授权」标记不再按岗位同名推算权限集。
- **为什么改**:#24757 已让运行时不再按岗位名授予同名权限集,服务端再也不会返回 `via: 'name'`;spec 和界面却还在描述这种已不存在的授权(#13419 裁决 B,18.x 直接退役)。
- **风险与回滚**:风险低。线上返回值不变(本来就全是 `'definition'`);TS 消费方若比较 `via === 'name'` 会编译报错,删掉该分支即可。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/managedEnvironmentUsers.tsx`(判定逻辑变化:同名岗位的持有人现在会被标「未授权」);`packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts`(公开类型收窄);`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.position-grant-via-name-retired.ts`(ADR-0087 登记)。
- **两分钟验证**:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/managedEnvironmentUsers-13330.test.tsx`,预期 16 个用例全绿,其中「a position grants nothing by sharing its name with a permission set」为新判定。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地(落地前欠一次 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 契约复核)。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/spec`**: `PositionGrantVia` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts`) is now `'definition'`. The docblock no longer describes the position-name fold. The security plugin already serves only `via: 'definition'` (`security-plugin.ts` `describePositionGrants`), so the wire answer does not change.
- **ADR-0087**: a new D3 semantic entry `position-grant-via-name-retired` registers the retirement. The type describes a served answer, not a stack collection or a metadata type, so there is no D2 conversion source. The changeset carries the `registered` disposition.
- **Setup → Positions** (`PositionGrantCells.tsx`): the granted-sets cell shows each set's name alone. The "(by name)" / 「（同名）」 badge, its hint, and the i18n keys `engine.position.grants.byName` and `engine.position.grants.byNameHint` (en and zh) are removed. The served-entry filter accepts only `via: 'definition'`.
- **Setup → Users on a managed environment** (`managedEnvironmentUsers.tsx`): the client-side name fold is retired. A held position now counts only by the sets its definition lists. The permission-set catalogue read, `catalogueRead`, and `PositionRegistrySource.getTypeStatus` existed only for the fold. Measured: no other reader in the file or in its one caller, `objectViewIdentity.tsx`. All three are removed, including the caller's `getTypeStatus` line. The observable change: a holder of a position whose name matches a permission set the definition does not list is now marked Not authorized, unless something else grants them a set beyond the baseline. That matches what the server enforces.
- **Docblock**: `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` (`describeMetaPositionList`) now says `via: 'definition'`.
- **Fixture triage** (consumer radius of the narrowed value, respelled to a declared set): `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts` and `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.listInclude-25333.test.ts` still served `via: 'name'` from their doubles. Both now serve `{ name: 'forecasting', via: 'definition' }`.

## Tests

- `managedEnvironmentUsers-13330.test.tsx`: the name-fold pin is inverted. A holder of `closer` (a position that shares its name with a set but lists only a baseline set) reads `baseline-only`. The control holder of `sales_rep` reads `beyond-baseline`. The registry is asked only for `position`. The "catalogue cannot be read" case is deleted because the read it covered is gone.
- `ResourceListPage.positionGrants-25333.test.tsx`: the fixture serves only declared sets. Each badge's text is exactly the set name and carries no `title`.
- Ablation, one-time: re-adding a name-based count, `beyondBaseline(position) ||` in the position branch, turns three cases red, the new one among them. The file was restored, and its blob equals HEAD (`044d3b83d42f`).

<details><summary>Local readings (head 1efc50f4, then merged head 1a70ed57)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: exit 0. `check:generated`: exit 0, all 14 artifacts up to date. The api-surface is unchanged because the export name stays.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 726/726 files, 21984 tests passed.
- `cd ui && vitest run` on the three touched test files: 3/3 files, 25/25 tests. Ablation run: 3 failed / 13 passed, as intended, then restored.
- `cd ui && vitest run` on `app-shell/src/views/__tests__/`, `metadata-admin/ResourceListPage*`, `zh-base-term`, all of `data-objectstack`, and `i18n` `objectView-config-keys-retired-4730`: 182/182 files, 1871/1871 tests, on both heads.
- `packages/runtime` `meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts`: 1/1 file, 878/878 tests.
- Type checks: `@object-ui/app-shell type-check` (both heads), `@object-ui/data-objectstack type-check`, `@objectstack/spec typecheck`, `@objectstack/rest typecheck` and `@objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0. Runtime first reported TS2307 for `@objectstack/driver-turso`, an unbuilt dist. It was green after building that package.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` on the final head 1a70ed57: 94 commands, all exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 94 derived, 94 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, a derived zero.

</details>

<details><summary>Full dogfood battery (final head 1a70ed57)</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock: 302 files (2 failed, 297 passed, 3 skipped), 2549 tests (10 failed, 2521 passed, 18 skipped). VERDICT command-exit 1.

All 10 failures are in `test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts` (4) and `test/authz-conformance.test.ts` #17111 (6). They count text in `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` and `packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts`, for example the control `this.routeManager.register(` is expected at 62 and found at 63. This PR does not touch either file or `packages/qa/dogfood`. `git diff origin/main` on all three is empty, so the same counts fail on `origin/main` (e931621a). They are main's, not this change's.

10 reds in authz-conformance.test.ts and authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts are main's at origin/main abb90460 (same 10, measured on a detached worktree), anchored on #26400; not this PR's.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts` (docblock of `describePositionGrants`, around line 3535) still says "the contract's `'name'` member is no longer served". The member is now gone, so the sentence goes stale. It is left alone because PR #26337 holds that file. Carrier: the seat.
- `.changeset/24757-retire-position-name-fold.md` (pending, from #24757) says the `'name'` member is "retired separately in #26022; until then the value is published but never served". It stays accurate as a record of that change and is not edited here.
- The full app-shell suite (about 1,800 files) was narrowed locally to the modules this diff reaches, listed above. CI's UI jobs run the rest.
- The full-battery dogfood reds above are pre-existing on `origin/main` (see the dogfood block). They are reported to the seat as a main-red finding, not fixed here.

## Verification

- Requires one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` contract review before the queue, as the claim records.
- No governed surface is touched. Changed lines are about 203, under the 3,000 threshold.
